title: Señal
subtitle: Volumen 1
logline: Una chica que se fija en todo es la única que nota el patrón oculto en el apagón que tiene la ciudad paralizada.

hero.name: Nerea
hero.hair: hair tied back in a ponytail, dark brown
hero.outfit: big over-ear headphones around the neck, slight build

ally.label: BRUNO
ally.sheet: A twelve-year-old boy with messy brown hair, a permanent smudge on his cheek, and a huge old laptop he carries in a backpack.

villain.label: SILEN
villain.sheet: A thin man in his forties, gray hair slicked back, pale eyes, always wearing a dark coat with a high collar, no tie.

cover.scene: comic book cover composition: the teenager standing in the foreground, the ally behind and to one side, and far back the silhouette of SILEN; a connected city where infrastructure itself is under attack, server halls, dark streets, dead traffic lights

critique.worst: Inconsistencia sobre la vigilancia del sótano: se dice 'sin vigilancia' pero Silen detecta la intrusión en pantalla, lo que rompe la lógica del clímax y la credibilidad del antagonista.

dialogue.note: Hay muchas réplicas creíbles y concisas, pero el texto alterna buen argot con pasajes demasiado explicativos o teatrales que suenan a adulto escribiendo, no a chicos de 15 años.

panels.scene: Wide shot of a sunlit urban sidewalk at morning. The teenager walks with earbuds in, eyes scanning the ground, walls and street fixtures.
Close-up of a freshly repainted square manhole cover on the asphalt, with an odd three-digit number stenciled in black on one corner.
The teenager crouched by the manhole cover, phone held low, framing the painted number with one hand steady.

bubbles.text: Genial... otro detalle que nadie pilla.

panels.scene: The younger brother sitting on a low wall at the school gate, laptop open on his knees, scrolling through a forum thread.

bubbles.text: Tío, mira: en el foro dicen que muchos cuadros vienen con admin/admin.

panels.scene: Medium two-shot: the younger brother on the laptop, the teenager standing over him, still holding her phone with the photo.

bubbles.text: Pues claro. Es que nadie cambia la contraseña de mierda por defecto, ¿no?
O eso.

panels.scene: Wide shot of a sunlit classroom from the back; rows of teenagers at desks, a teacher's hand writing on a whiteboard under fluorescent light.
Medium close-up of the teenage girl, mid-row, head tilted, eyes narrowing as the fluorescent tube above her flickers twice and dies; the rest of the room goes dim.

bubbles.text: Genial.

panels.scene: Cut to the corridor drinking fountain sputtering dry, a thin dribble of water hitting the cracked tile floor; lockers reflected in the metal surface.

bubbles.text: Después, se cuela algo, o sea...

panels.scene: View through the classroom window: the street intersection below, every traffic light dead, cars idling, a delivery truck half-blocking the crosswalk.

bubbles.text: Silencio.

panels.scene: Close-up of the girl's wrist, her smartwatch still ticking steadily under the dim emergency strip light; in the blurred background, students tapping dead phone screens.

bubbles.text: No es un corte. Esto tiene huella — alguien ha tocado la ciudad.

panels.scene: Over-the-shoulder shot: through the window the street lamps are still glowing amber, while across the road a phone mast displays a blank red LED.

bubbles.text: La red?

panels.scene: Wide shot of a dimly lit school corridor, students crowding toward the exits, ceiling lights off, emergency strips casting a faint green line along the floor.

bubbles.text: Tres minutos después — Instituto Vallecas.

panels.scene: A teacher standing in a doorway, arms half-raised, tie loosened, looking harried, flashlight in one hand pointing at the floor.

bubbles.text: Tranquilos... fallo general. Salida ordenada, sin empujones, ¿vale?

panels.scene: Close-up on a ceiling-mounted security camera, small red diode blinking steadily, its lens angled outward through a dark window.
The teenager, backpack half-on one shoulder, standing still in the moving crowd, eyes tilted up toward the camera, frown pulled sideways, mouth a thin line.

bubbles.text: Si todo está caído... ¿por qué esto sigue funcionando?

panels.scene: Low angle from behind a phone screen lying on a hallway windowsill, the lock screen showing 17:48, no signal bars, a single battery icon.

bubbles.text: ¿Vienes?

panels.scene: The teenager turning back toward her younger brother, still looking over her shoulder, hand gripping the strap of her backpack.

bubbles.text: Espera — algo no cuadra.

panels.scene: Close-up of a smartphone screen glowing in a dim hallway, notification banner from the municipal channel, official municipal logo visible, no people in frame.

bubbles.text: 20:14. Nada es normal.

panels.scene: Tighter crop on the same screen, the message body filling the frame, small municipal icon next to a fresh corporate logo.

bubbles.text: Canal oficial Ayuntamiento. SeguraTotal: servicio restablecido en el centro. Contrato exprés activo.

panels.scene: Medium shot of the teenager in a dark corridor, phone light cutting across her face, one hand holding the device, the other gripping the strap of her backpack.

bubbles.text: Sale del repetidor municipal... está tocado.

panels.scene: Cutaway to a graphic detail: the corporate logo beside the municipal one, slight color mismatch suggesting a layered overlay.
Wider shot, the teenager turns sharply toward a side door where faint light spills in, jaw set, eyes tracking something off-panel.

bubbles.text: Ven. Ya.

panels.scene: A small bedroom at night, lit only by a laptop screen on a desk. A younger boy sits hunched over the keyboard, the glow catching the edge of a grin.

bubbles.text: Tranquila, ya tengo el portátil listo. Cuando vuelva la luz, rastreo qué han tocado.

panels.scene: The same bedroom, over the teenager's shoulder. The phone in her hand shows a notification from the city hall channel.

bubbles.text: ¿SeguraTotal? Menudo nombre. Contrato exprés... ¿será trampa?

panels.scene: The younger boy still at the laptop, but the grin fades. He glances sideways, eyes sharper now.

bubbles.text: Ese mensaje salió del repetidor que petó. ¿Cómo coño han transmitido—desde ahí?

panels.scene: An empty street seen through a window. One pedestrian traffic light works steady green, while the others around it blink out of sync.
Tight shot from the window: the teenager's face reflected against the glass, the working traffic light centered behind her. Her eyes narrow, lips pressed.

bubbles.text: No cuadra.

panels.scene: The younger brother crouched at the base of a rusted telecom repeater on a deserted sidewalk, laptop open and glowing against his face, typing with one hand while the other holds a flash drive.

bubbles.text: Entré, joder.

panels.scene: Tight view of the laptop screen: a faded admin panel with a list of node IDs, some marked offline in red, one highlighted in pale yellow. A password field at the top, already filled.
The teenager standing beside her brother, leaning close to the screen, squinting against the reflection of a streetlight on the glass.

bubbles.text: Espera... ahí, en la esquina. Con este reflejo no lo pillo bien.

panels.scene: Closer angle on the teen's profile as she tilts her head sideways to read past the glare, a folded paper and a pen pressed against the laptop lid.
Over the younger brother's shoulder: the screen now shows the string NODO-7C in the corner, its last two characters partly hidden by a glint on the glass.

bubbles.text: Apúntalo ya, que con un toque lo pierdo.

panels.scene: Close-up of her hand writing NODO-7C on a torn piece of paper, pen pressed hard, the repeater's blinking indicator reflecting off the page.

bubbles.text: Huele raro.

panels.scene: A dim bedroom lit only by a laptop screen; a 15-year-old girl sits cross-legged on the bed, a notebook open on her knee, pen hovering over a blank line.

bubbles.text: Si esto se va al garete... que al menos no parezca un drama.

panels.scene: Close-up of the notebook page: a handwritten sentence in Spanish, underlined twice, with a signature line beneath.

bubbles.text: Nada de amenazas. Sin postureo. Datos claros y firma.

panels.scene: The younger brother hunched over the laptop on a desk cluttered with cables, the bedroom door cracked open behind him, house router blinking on a shelf.

bubbles.text: Directo.
Bruno, el router sale en la cabecera.

panels.scene: The girl's hand presses down on the laptop lid edge, knuckles pale, her face half in shadow.

bubbles.text: Ya. Lo tenemos.

panels.scene: A long exterior shot of a residential street at night: every streetlight on the block is dead, only the faint glow of a phone screen from a window.

bubbles.text: Esa noche. 00:47.

panels.scene: Inside a dark server room, a single monitor displays scrolling logs; a silhouetted figure leans forward, one finger tapping a node identifier on the screen.
Exterior of a modest apartment block at dawn, two municipal technicians in dark jackets ringing the intercom, their van parked across the street with a city cybersecurity unit logo.

bubbles.text: Al día siguiente. Antes de las nueve.

panels.scene: From behind the teenager's shoulder, watching her open the door to two uniformed technicians holding a tablet, the mother's face half-lit from the hallway.

bubbles.text: ¿Hay algún adulto en casa? Tenemos que hablar con un responsable.

panels.scene: Close-up of the tablet screen showing router logs, a highlighted public IP address and a timestamp, the mother's hand gripping the doorframe.

bubbles.text: Aquí pone que la subida salió de este router...

panels.scene: The younger brother crouched on his bed in a dim room, laptop open, sweat on his temple, curtains half-drawn against late afternoon light.

bubbles.text: Si lo borro antes de que lleguen... no sabrán nada.

panels.scene: Top-down of the laptop keyboard, trash bin icon emptying, progress bars filling, external drive being yanked from the USB port, a tangle of cables.

bubbles.text: Esa tarde.

panels.scene: The younger brother sitting on the edge of his bed, lid closed on his knees, staring at the dark window where two streetlamps have gone out, a single phone notification glowing on the nightstand.

bubbles.text: Me está costando. Pero no saben que fui yo.

panels.scene: Small bedroom lit only by a phone screen, the teenager sitting cross-legged on the bed, a pile of printed photos spread across the duvet.
Over-the-shoulder close-up of the phone screen showing a gallery of street photos; one thumb scrolls slowly past a traffic-light shot.
Tight crop on a single photo pinned under a finger: a dark street, a green construction hoarding reading 'SeguraTotal - Obras Municipales' in the background.
Same photo now one of three lined up on the screen, each taken on a different day but all sharing the same corporate hoarding in frame.

bubbles.text: Siempre la misma firma. Siempre cuando se va la luz... ¿casualidad?

panels.scene: The phone lowered to her lap, screen fading to black; her face half in shadow, eyes fixed on nothing, jaw tight.

bubbles.text: Mi culpa.

panels.scene: Wide of the empty bedroom, duvet rumpled, phone face-down on the pillow, the window behind reflecting a dead traffic light at the end of the street.
Early morning, pre-dawn city street lit only by distant sodium lamps; a teenager walks alone with her head down, eyes on the pavement, hood up, breath fogging slightly.
Close-up of asphalt: a freshly painted square utility cover with a hand-scratched number, still smelling of wet paint, framed by dark tarmac.
Wider street view, low angle: three similar painted square covers lined along a sidewalk, each with its own number, while an older round metal cover sits unnumbered further down the road.
Another empty avenue, traffic lights dead overhead; the teenager stands still on the curb, glancing back toward a cross-street where the lights are working again.

bubbles.text: No es al azar.

panels.scene: Medium shot from the side: the teenager walks on, eyes now scanning the sidewalk like she's counting something, jaw tight, hands buried in her pockets.

bubbles.text: Lo hicieron rápido; despistan para que yo pierda el hilo —mi mensaje... joder, trajo a Bruno.

panels.scene: Tight close-up of her face, half in shadow from a flickering lamp; one eye catches the cold light, the other lost in dark.

bubbles.text: Mi culpa.

panels.scene: Low angle on a teenager crouched beside a square metal hatch in the pavement, holding an old polaroid photo next to a freshly painted number in white. Dim streetlight, dead traffic lights in the background.

bubbles.text: No es casualidad... alguien quería que lo encontráramos.

panels.scene: Close-up of the polaroid and the painted hatch side by side, the matching numbers circled with a finger. No people, just the photo and the metal surface.
The younger brother sitting on a bed, laptop balanced on his knees, color back in his face, screen casting green light on him.

bubbles.text: Cruzo el número con la configuración del repetidor... espera.

panels.scene: Over-the-shoulder view of the laptop screen: a terminal showing a match between the painted code and a node ID labeled NODE-7C, with a partial street address beneath it.

bubbles.text: Nodo-7C. Sótano municipal. No hay vigilancia.

panels.scene: Wide shot of the teenager pulling on a jacket, the polaroid and a small notebook visible in her hand. Her brother stands up behind her, laptop under his arm.

bubbles.text: Es lo único que tenemos. Salimos ya.
Vale.

panels.scene: Fire escape staircase seen from above, rusted metal steps descending into a dark municipal basement corridor lit only by a flickering emergency lamp.

bubbles.text: Venga. Escalera de incendios, ahora.

panels.scene: Inside the basement: the younger brother crouches by a wall, phone flashlight on, checking a hand-drawn number on an old square manhole cover.

bubbles.text: NODO-7C.

panels.scene: Wide shot of a dim server hallway with closed metal doors; at the far end, a node cabinet stands against the wall, cables spilling out.
A workstation screen in a dark room: an alert pops up showing two heat signatures entering the basement floor plan.

bubbles.text: Joder... ya.

panels.scene: The teenager grabs the younger brother's arm and pulls him toward the node cabinet, urgent movement, low angle.

bubbles.text: ¡Al armario, corre! Yo te cubro la puerta — tú desconecta lo mínimo y rápido.

panels.scene: The younger brother sprints down the hallway, jacket flying, toward the patch panel cabinet at the end.
Close-up of a teenager girl pinned against a basement door frame, a hand snatching a smartphone from her grip, her knuckles white against the metal bar she is still holding across the door.

bubbles.text: Dame eso. No tienes ni puta idea con quién juegas; se acabó.

panels.scene: Tight shot of the girl's hand slipping a single wireless earpiece from her jacket pocket, low blue light from a server rack catching the small white plastic.

bubbles.text: Perfecto.

panels.scene: Detail shot of a small printed sign nailed to the bare concrete wall, a handwritten MAC address under a row of arrows pointing to different cables, dust on the staples.
The girl crouches beside an open server rack, comparing the MAC on the wall sign with a sticker on the rack door, eyes flicking back and forth, one earpiece in her ear.

bubbles.text: 7C:A3. Solo tira el cable con esa etiqueta. Ni toques otros. ¿Me sigues?

panels.scene: The younger boy in front of the patch panel, fingers tracing a row of ethernet cables until they stop on one, a strip of tape under it with the matching MAC scrawled in marker.

bubbles.text: 7C:A3... Vale. ¿Solo este? ¿Seguro?

panels.scene: Wide shot from street level: half the intersection lit again, traffic signals blinking green, a few streetlamps humming back on, the other half of the block still dark, a distant siren.

bubbles.text: Que sea solo un parche.

panels.scene: Newspaper page spread on a kitchen counter, morning light from a window, headline about the blackout with a subheading reading 'AYUNTAMIENTO ABRE INVESTIGACIÓN', mug of coffee casting a shadow.

bubbles.text: A la mañana siguiente.

panels.scene: The teenager sitting at the counter, holding the newspaper open with both hands, eyes narrowed at a small photo on the page. Toast untouched on a plate.

bubbles.text: Espera...

panels.scene: Close-up of the newspaper photo: an official shot of the consistory office, rows of chairs behind a polished table, one office chair slightly out of line, rotated towards the wall.
The younger brother leaning over the counter, looking at a phone photo he took in the basement: the same chair, same model, same scuff on the left armrest, next to a patch panel in dim light.

bubbles.text: ¿Tú estás metido en esto?

panels.scene: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind the younger brother: his face lit by the phone screen, newspaper on the left, his basement photo on the right, both showing the matching chair.

bubbles.text: Pues el listo la dejó ahí para volver, tío.
